axis_levels.definition: Per-position aligned-residue count divided by the total reported homology hits.
axis_levels.levels: Unique positions are ranked within each assay with position as the deterministic tie-breaker; three levels are primary and five levels are a denser check. All substitutions at a position share its level.

model_evaluation.description: Assay-local substitutions are mapped to the pinned Swiss-Prot canonical sequence before joining official AlphaMissense scores by accession and mapped substitution. Exact substring offsets are used when available, otherwise local sequence alignment with a matching wild-type residue is required.
model_evaluation.score_source: Released official AlphaMissense amino-acid substitution scores.
model_evaluation.performance: Absolute Spearman correlation of released AlphaMissense scores with DMS measurements within each eligible assay and level.
comparators: BLOSUM62 substitution scores recalculated from variant amino acids.
PSSM log-ratio scores recalculated from raw aligned residue counts with one pseudocount per standard amino acid.

curve.aggregation_and_uncertainty: Paired high-minus-low effects average eligible assays with both extremes for all three predictors; 95% intervals bootstrap assays (5000 draws, seed 0). Values here retain the displayed precision.
